name: Hushai
overview: Hushai, identified as David's faithful friend, played a crucial role during a time of crisis when David fled from Absalom. Upon meeting David at the mount where he worshiped God, Hushai was instructed to return to Jerusalem and serve Absalom as a double agent to undermine the counsel of Ahithophel. He was also tasked with relaying information from the king's house to David through the priests Zadok and Abiathar, demonstrating his loyalty and strategic importance in preserving David's kingship.
